_meta.adr: ADR-044 unified-case — subsidy applications fold into the unified case model as the 'subsidie' caseType (seeded in lib/Settings/bezwaar_seed_data.json, uuid b3c1a000-0000-4000-a000-0000000005ab). The bespoke subsidieAanvraag index is replaced by a Cases index pre-filtered to that caseType. subsidieAanvraag remains a SUPPORTING schema linked to the case (case.$ref via subsidieAanvraag.case) carrying the subsidy-specific detail (regeling, requested/granted amount, begroting, beschikking); the case carries the common workflow/status. subsidieRegeling stays a config register surfaced under settings. The SubsidieDetail route + subsidieAanvraag schema stay registered for deep links to the linked detail data.
_meta.data-model-decision: Option (b) — linked detail schema. subsidieAanvraag already declares a `case` property ($ref:case, onDelete:SET_NULL), so subsidy cases use the generic `case` workflow while subsidy-specific fields live on the linked subsidieAanvraag record. The `case` schema is NOT bloated with subsidy-only properties.

config._note: CASE-linked detail archetype (subsidy application). Per ADR-044 the subsidy WORKFLOW lives on a unified `case` (caseType=subsidie) shown by CaseDetail; subsidieAanvraag is the SUPPORTING schema (subsidieAanvraag.case) holding subsidy-specific data reached by deep link. It declares NO comms linkedTypes. Overview data+metadata carries the application (aanvraagnummer, subsidieregeling, aangevraagdBedrag, status, behandelaar, the linked case). A Begroting tab groups the budget (begroting, cofinancieringList, projectStartdatum/Einddatum); a Aanvrager tab isolates the applicant references (aanvragerKvkRef, aanvragerBsnRef). Audit-trail closes it. The previous CaseDecisionsTab/CaseDocumentsTab were replaced because they filter decision.case/caseDocument.case by the route id — which here is a subsidieAanvraag id, not a case id, so they never matched; the beschikking + bewijsstukken belong to the parent case dossier (CaseDetail).
